artworks.title: The Holy Kinship
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures with varying degrees of their body visible. One prominent figure on the right is seated and turned slightly away from the viewer, with a head covering and robes. Surrounding figures include a child being held by an adult with curly hair. The setting is indoors with ornate architectural elements like columns and a finely sculpted balustrade. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape with buildings. Above the main scene, small cherub-like figures are positioned on a ledge. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects used by the figures except for their attire and fabric patterns.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in a Church
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a child. The woman is standing, holding the child in her arms. Her facial features are delicate, with a serene expression. Her hair is mostly covered by a headdress or elaborate covering, extending over her shoulders. The child has curly hair and is positioned against the woman's body, both surrounded by halos. The woman wears a flowing garment with intricate details and a decorative element on her chest. In her hand, she holds a small cross. The child clutches her shoulder. The scene is set in a structure resembling a church or cathedral with tall arches and windows allowing light to illuminate the figures. The background includes stone pillars and a patterned floor.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure surrounded by various angelic beings. The central figure is in a swirling cloud-like aura, appearing to rise, carrying a banner. Angelic figures surround the scene in the sky, while below, there are soldiers, knights, and religious figures. The background is dense and detailed, adding contrast between the celestial and earthly realms.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: This print shows two people, one adult and one child. The adult is crouched down, using a long staff or tree branch for support, their body slightly turned to the right. This person has a rugged appearance with long, disheveled hair, and they are wearing a heavy, draped cloak that billows out behind them. The child appears to be seated on the adult’s shoulders, pointing downward with one finger. They have short hair and closely fitted clothing. The background features leafy foliage and a large tree on the right, with distant buildings visible. The background is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher Seated by a River Bank
artworks.description: The image depicts an old man sitting on the ground holding a stick, while a smaller figure, possibly a child, stands next to him also holding a stick. They are under a large tree with detailed bark. The background shows mountains, trees, and a town in the distance, suggesting a rural landscape. The artwork features fine line work, cross-hatching, and a monochrome color scheme of black and off-white.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Cave
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene within a cave-like setting. The scene features an area with an altar adorned with a cross on top of a twisted object in the center. Surrounding the altar are detailed elements, including hanging stalactites or roots, and textured surfaces suggesting a rocky or organic interior. To the left, there is a large animal near an individual in detailed attire performing a gesture associated with prayer or reflection. In the background, the cave structure leads to vaulted openings revealing architecture or buildings. The drawing is textured with linework, creating depth through shadow and light. The atmosphere conveys a sense of quiet contemplation in a detailed and enclosed space.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt at a Fountain
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring a grand fountain within a vaulted chamber. The drawing depicts a setting with gothic-style arches and a large fountain positioned centrally. The fountain is adorned with carvings and sculptural elements, including figures and creatures. The vaulted ceiling is detailed, emphasizing light and shadow. The scene showcases elaborate artistry typical of Renaissance or gothic-inspired architecture and design.

artworks.title: Pyramus and Thisbe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored figure assisting another figure lying on the ground in an outdoor setting. The background includes detailed foliage and possibly a wooden structure or wall. The armored figure is depicted with intricate armor, and the scene is richly textured with dense hatching. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer, known for detailed woodcuts and engravings.

artworks.title: The Standard Bearer
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is in a dynamic pose, with one leg slightly forward and an arm raised. His head is slightly tilted, and he has a beard and short, wavy hair. The man is wearing intricately detailed armor with various patterns, scales, and textures. He holds a sword in his right hand, which is resting on the ground. The background includes fields, a small town, mountains, trees, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Pair of Lovers in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows two figures sitting closely together on the ground. They are depicted from head to toe, with their heads tilted toward each other. The person on the left has a robust build and faces the other figure. Both wear period-style clothing with intricate patterns and puffed sleeves. They have headwear, with the person on the left wearing a large hat with a plume. The background consists of trees and shrubbery, rendered in a detailed style typical of woodcuts.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Two Boys
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a baby, with two children beside her.

artworks.title: The Virgin with the Blessing Child in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on the ground, holding a child in her lap. The woman faces to her right, while the child stands on her lap, looking outward with one arm raised. The woman has a serene expression and long hair covered with a headscarf. The child has curly hair. Both figures wear halos. The scene includes detailed grass and rock textures. In the background, there are trees with foliage reaching into the sky, cloud patterns, distant mountains, and a rustic structure resembling a house or barn on the left side.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Courtyard
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a bearded figure walking in front of an architectural background. The scene displays a long-bearded figure in tattered clothing, leaning forward and holding a staff in one hand while a lion crouches behind him. The figure's expression appears concentrated. The background architecture features intricate stonework and arches, hinting at a medieval or Renaissance setting. The texture, line work, and detailing are elaborate, characteristic of the engraving technique. The composition balances the interaction between the human figure, the animal, and the architectural elements around them.

artworks.title: The Large Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a wooden cross with a figure crucified upon it, highlighted by radiant lines emanating from the figure's head, while a crowd gathers at the base. The drawing shows the cross in the center and surrounded by several trees. In the foreground, a group of mourners can be seen at the base of the cross, their postures suggesting grief and sorrow. The background features a town with medieval-style buildings. The intricate cross-hatching technique adds depth and texture to the drawing.

artworks.title: The Little Standard Bearer
artworks.description: This print depicts a man standing upright. He is slightly angled to the right and wears a large, plumed hat that partially covers his head. The man's facial features include a straight nose, deep-set eyes, a long mustache, and slightly furrowed eyebrows. He is dressed in an outfit featuring a doublet with puffed sleeves, short breeches, and knee-length boots. A round object appears to hang from his waist. His right hand is on his hip, and the other one is draped by cascading fabric from a flag or banner he holds that extends upward behind his head. The background shows a landscape with hills, a castle, and smaller buildings against a sky decorated with thin horizontal lines. The print is on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Venus with Two Putti
artworks.artist: Albrecht Altdorfer after Peregrino da Cesena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a flame and a torch. The central figure is standing confidently, carrying a heart-shaped object in one hand, engulfed in flames, and a large torch in the other. At her feet are two smaller figures, one crouching with a stick and the other reaching up towards the central figure while holding a small frame or tablet. The backdrop is detailed with cross-hatching patterns.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This drawing depicts mythological figures in a natural setting. The central part of the image shows several figures gathered in an outdoor environment. The setting is lush with vegetation, dominated by a large tree in the background. The drawing is detailed and cross-hatched, creating depth and texture. The arrangement of the figures and their gestures suggest a narrative or allegory. The figures are depicted with a strong emphasis on form and pose, similar to the style of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg Seated in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, one adult and one child, sitting together. Both figures are visible from the waist up. The adult figure is positioned slightly to the left, turned towards the child they are holding. The adult has a head covering that resembles a traditional hood. The child has curly hair and is looking towards the adult figure. The adult is wearing a garment with decorative patterns, including a border of fringe or tassels, while the child is draped in a simple cloth. The child seems to be holding a small object. In the background, there is a halo-like pattern behind the adult figure's head and a tree with leaves and branches to the right. The image is monochromatic, likely created using etching techniques with detailed shading and line work.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Reading
artworks.description: The image shows a partial figure of a man from the head to the knees standing and leaning slightly forward with one hand on an open book on a table or altar. The man has a beard and is looking at the book. He has short, somewhat unkempt hair, and is draped in a piece of fabric, leaving his upper torso uncovered. Next to the book on the table are a crucifix and a burning candle. In the background is an archway revealing a distant landscape with hills and a small structure or village visible. A lion lies at the man's feet behind the table. The scene is set indoors, indicated by the arched frame and the textures of stone and foliage.

artworks.title: The Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg on an Altar
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman seated on a throne, holding a child. The woman has a gentle expression and her hair is covered. The child is leaning against her. Surrounding them are angels playing musical instruments. The throne is ornately carved with decorative panels. The background features a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Christ Expelling the Money Changers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene of an arched building featuring several figures. The image presents an elaborate architectural setting with high vaulted ceilings and numerous arches lining the sides. The primary figure appears to be in motion, bent forward in a dynamic pose, with one arm extended and holding objects in the other hand. In the foreground, a scene unfolds on the tiled floor with two figures, one of whom is on its knees, seemingly picking up or examining objects. Additional figures can also be seen in the background, moving or engaged in various activities. The meticulous hatching and cross-hatching techniques emphasize depth and contrast, typical of detailed line work and etching styles.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image depicts a religious scene of a crucifixion. A figure is shown on a cross, wearing a crown of thorns and a loincloth. Cherubic faces with wings are seen in the sky with bursts of light. On the left is a woman in robes with a circular halo, and on the right is another figure with a halo. The background shows a landscape with buildings and hills.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight on horseback slaying a dragon in a fantasy landscape. The drawing depicts a knight in ornate armor riding a horse, wielding a long lance to engage with a dragon with large coiled features. In the background, there are mountains, a castle, and trees. One figure is standing and watching the combat. The drawing is detailed, showing textures of the horse's mane, knight's armor, and dragon's scales.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.5 x 4.7 cm (3 3/4 x 1 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two people and a child in elaborate clothing and hats. One person stands with a cane while the other is seated holding an infant. In the background, there is a detailed castle-like structure against a mountain, with swirling clouds in the sky above. The image is drawn in a fine engraving style with black and white tones.
